description:
[Deterministic CPR construction material compliance. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits Declaration of Performance and Conformity (DoP&C) under Construction Products Regulation CPR (EU) 2024/2773 and harmonized EN standards (EN 10025, EN 206, EN 771, EN 13162), verifies AVCP System & Notified Body (NANDO), and benchmarks EPD Global Warming Potential (GWP A1-A3).
Usage: Use this tool to verify CE marking eligibility and environmental performance for structural steel, concrete, bricks, and insulation.
Returns: JSON object with { isDoPCompliant: boolean, ceMarkingPermitted: boolean, standardVerification: object, avcpVerification: object, environmentalBenchmarking: object }.

epdData.description: EPD Global Warming Potential module A1-A3 data

harmonizedStandard.description: Harmonized standard (e.g. EN 10025-2, EN 206, EN 771-1, EN 13162)

name: construction_materials_cpr_audit
